transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you here today?

Well... mostly I'm just here 'cause I don't sleep right anymore. 

I just... I lie there a long time. And when I do drift off, I end up waking up from... well, bad dreams, or just little noises. After that, I can't seem to settle back down. 

So... that's why I'm here.

When you have trouble falling or staying asleep, is it usually despite having enough time and a good chance to sleep? And during the day, do you feel tired or have trouble focusing because of the poor sleep?

I got plenty of time. I ain't working no more, so... the time is there. I just don't sleep. 

During the day... I don't know. I get by alright, I guess. Ain't really noticed much trouble focusing or nothing. I just go about my business.
Even though you're not working, do you ever feel unusually sleepy or fatigued during the day, even after a full night's rest?
No... not really. I ain't falling asleep in my chair during the day or nothing. Just feel... regular, I guess.
Do you ever feel upset or bothered by how you’re sleeping these days?
Not really. I mean... it is what it is. I just figure it's part of getting older, you know? Ain't no use getting worked up over it.
Has your sleep trouble ever made it hard for you to enjoy your usual activities, or caused you any real distress?
No... I still do what I normally do. It don't really... get in the way of nothing. Like I said, it ain't causing me no real grief.
How often do you wake up during the night from bad dreams or noises, and does anything happen during those times that might explain why you can't fall back asleep?

Well... that's mostly why I'm here, I guess. I just don't sleep right anymore. I lie there for a long time trying to drift off... and then I wake up. Sometimes it's bad dreams, sometimes it's just little noises. And once I'm up... I just can't seem to settle back down.
While you're asleep, do you ever do anything unusual, like talking, walking around, or gasping for air?
No... don't think so. I mean, I ain't never woke up walking around or nothing like that. Just... just what I already told you.
How often do you have trouble falling asleep or staying asleep — is it happening at least three nights every week?

I reckon it's... most nights. Yeah, at least three. Like I said, I just don't sleep right anymore. I lie there a long time... and then I wake up from them dreams or noises, and I can't settle back down. It's just... happening a lot.
Would you say you have plenty of time and a good chance to sleep each night, like being in a quiet, comfortable place without interruptions?
Yeah... I got the time. Room's quiet enough. Ain't nobody bothering me or nothing. Just... like I said, I just can't sleep.
How long has this problem with not sleeping right been going on?
It's... it's been a while now. Guess it started right after I fell off that ladder... about a year and seven months back, give or take.
Do you have any pain, discomfort, or physical symptoms that tend to bother you at night and make it harder to fall or stay asleep?
No... ain't nothing like that. I mean, I get a little stiff sometimes, being my age, but... ain't no pain keeping me up. It's just... ain't pain that's doing it.
Do you ever notice yourself snoring loudly or gasping for air while you're asleep?
No... ain't noticed nothing like that. I live alone, so... ain't nobody to tell me if I did, but... don't wake up gasping or nothing. Just... just don't sleep.
When you're first trying to fall asleep, do you have trouble getting to sleep, or is most of your sleep problem about staying asleep after you've already fallen asleep?

Guess it's a bit of both. I just... I lie there a long time trying to drift off. And then... well, I end up waking up anyway. Hear little noises, or... have bad dreams, I guess. Once I'm awake, I just can't seem to settle back down.
Even though you said you have time to sleep, do you sometimes feel like you can't sleep even when you really try and have a good chance to rest?
I don't rightly know. I mean... I got nothing but time. Nobody's bothering me. I try to rest, but... it just don't happen. Like I said.
Even when you have a good chance to sleep and you’re in a comfortable, quiet place, do you still have trouble falling or staying asleep?
Yeah... it's like I said. Quiet don't seem to matter. Just... can't sleep.
